title: `additionalProperties`
description: Controls whether an object accepts keys that are not declared in its properties map.
question: Is each object's additional-properties policy preserved at the capture boundary?
notes: Four measured capture boundaries preserve the source policy. CrewAI's generated args_schema changes additionalProperties on the root and nested object schemas.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: Pydantic model generation rewrites additionalProperties on several object boundaries, changing whether undeclared keys are accepted.

verdict.headline: Preserved at four boundaries, changed at one.
verdict.detail: CrewAI rewrites the policy while the other captured definitions retain it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP tool schemas declaring additionalProperties.
known_issues: A changed policy can make a downstream caller reject valid extension keys or send keys the server rejects.
why: Object openness is part of the parameter contract. Changing it can alter which calls validate before they reach the server.
reproduce: uv run mcp-mirror scan "uv run python fixtures/tricky_server.py" --runner managed --frameworks crewai,langchain,openai_agents,pydantic_ai --spec-version 2025-11-25 --job J2,J3
